Tum kya kr skte ho?

Aapki madad karne ke liye humari samarthya hai.

Hum REC Bijnor mein aapko yeh jankari pradan kar sakte hain:

- AICTE (All India Council for Technical Education) ke dwara sanrakshit hain.
- AKTU, Lucknow (Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University) ke saath sambandhit hain.

Agar aapko koi vishesh jankari chahiye, to kripaya humare sahayak vibhag ke saath sambandh karke unse sampark karein.
Kya haal h tumhara?

Main theek hoon. Rajkiya Engineering College, Bijnor ke bare mein aapko sabhi jankari uplabdh hai. Yahaan aapko college ki pramukh visheshtaein aur pramanikta ke bare mein jaankari mil sakti hai. Agar aapko koi vishesh jankari chahti hai, to aap mujhe puch sakte hain.
